# Rosetta Stone

> Rosetta Stone is a comprehensive language learning platform using Dynamic Immersion methodology and TruAccent speech recognition to teach 25+ languages across personal, educational, and enterprise markets.

Rosetta Stone offers immersive online language courses for learners of all proficiency levels, with specialized solutions for individuals, K-12 schools, and corporate training. The platform emphasizes natural language acquisition through interactive lessons, speech recognition technology, and regional dialect options across major world languages.

## Key Topics

- Dynamic Immersion
- TruAccent speech recognition
- Language proficiency levels
- Online language courses
- Spanish learning
- French lessons
- English lessons
- German lessons
- Chinese Mandarin
- Arabic lessons
- Lifetime access
- Pronunciation tips
- Corporate training
- School language programs
- Beginner to advanced proficiency

## Solutions by Market

- [Corporate Language Training Courses and Assessments](https://www.rosettastone.com/business): Rosetta Stone Enterprise corporate training with CEFR assessments and live tutoring.
- [Rosetta Stone for Schools](https://www.rosettastone.com/schools): Rosetta Stone for Schools platform with LMS integration for 25 languages.

## Major Languages

- [Learn Spanish Online](https://www.rosettastone.com/learn-spanish): Spanish lessons for Latin America covering Mexico City, Buenos Aires, and Spain.
- [Learn French Online](https://www.rosettastone.com/learn-french): French language lessons for France, Africa, Canada, and Europe regions.
- [Learn English Online](https://www.rosettastone.com/learn-english): English lessons for US, UK, and Canada with beginner to advanced proficiency.
- [Learn German Online](https://www.rosettastone.com/learn-german): German lessons for Germany, Austria, and Switzerland regions.
- [Learn Chinese Online](https://www.rosettastone.com/learn-chinese): Mandarin Chinese lessons for China and Taiwan regions.
- [Learn Arabic Online](https://www.rosettastone.com/learn-arabic): Arabic lessons covering Cairo, Marrakech, and Dubai regions.

## Regional Language Variants

- [Learn Spanish (Spain)](https://www.rosettastone.com/learn-spanish-spain): Spain Spanish lessons for Madrid, Barcelona, and Seville regions.
- [Learn English (British)](https://www.rosettastone.com/learn-english-british): British English lessons for UK, Ireland, Australia, and New Zealand.
- [Learn Italian Online](https://www.rosettastone.com/learn-italian): Italian lessons covering Tuscany, Venice, and Italy pronunciation.

## Additional Languages

- [Learn Dutch Online](https://www.rosettastone.com/learn-dutch): Dutch lessons for Netherlands, Belgium, and Suriname regions.
- [Learn Farsi Online](https://www.rosettastone.com/learn-farsi-persian): Farsi Persian lessons for Iran and Afghanistan regions.
- [Learn Greek Online](https://www.rosettastone.com/learn-greek): Greek lessons for Athens and Thessaloniki with historical context.
- [Learn Hebrew Online](https://www.rosettastone.com/learn-hebrew): Hebrew lessons for Israel with immersive learning approach.
